dimensions.detail: Name/description describe an API-backed market-data integrator and the only required secret is TICKERDB_KEY (primaryEnv). No unrelated binaries, credentials, or config paths are requested.

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to call tickerdb.com endpoints, walk users through email/code auth if no key exists, validate tickers with GET /v1/summary/{ticker}, and optionally set up reports/watchlists. These steps are within the advertised scope and do not instruct reading unrelated files or other system secrets.

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent: it only needs your TICKERDB_KEY and makes requests to api.tickerdb.com. Before installing, confirm you trust TickerDB and the platform to store your API key (the skill will ask to save it if you consent). Don’t share unrelated credentials. If you prefer not to allow automatic or recurring reports, check or disable autonomous invocation/report scheduling in your agent settings. If you want stronger guarantees, create a TickerDB key with limited scope or a separate account for integration.
